data: In fiscal 2024, Apple spent about $31.37 billion on research and development, according to its fiscal year ended September 28, 2024. That was roughly 8% of its $391.0 billion in net sales and up from $29.92 billion in fiscal 2023. Tesla reported R&D expense of about $4.54 billion for fiscal 2024, the calendar year ended December 31, 2024. That was roughly 4.7% of its $97.7 billion in revenue and up from $3.97 billion in 2023. Apple's R&D spending was therefore about 6.9 times larger than Tesla's, a gap of roughly $26.8 billion. Note that the two fiscal years end at different times, September for Apple and December for Tesla.
